blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO. Agusan del Sur — Eight Chinese nationals and 10 Filipino workers were arrested while heavy machinery and extraction equipment valued at P153.3 million were impounded following a multi-agency operation against an alleged illegal mining operation in Surigao City, Surigao del Norte, on Wednesday. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director, said the joint operation was conducted in an alleged illegal mining site in the upland village of Barangay Mabini.
